blurb: Goodwood Kartways operates on over 20 acres of rolling hills and offers karting programs for all ages and skill levels, including the Arrive and Drive program, TRAK club racing, and a Kid Kart program for ages 4-7. The facility hosts events from birthday parties to national championships and provides high performance racing karts and safety equipment. Group and corporate events are customizable with training, track time, and podium presentations.
